title: PTI Leaders Denied Access to Imran Khan at Adiala Jail Despite IHC Order
detail: A PTI delegation of six leaders — including Seemabia Tahir, Usman Jora, and Malik Yasir Patwali — arrived at Adiala Jail, Rawalpindi, on June 4 for a court-authorized meeting with jailed party founder Imran Khan. Jail authorities refused entry, citing a pending approval notification, and the delegation waited from 2 p.m. until the 4 p.m. cutoff without being admitted. The Islamabad High Court had previously ordered twice-weekly meetings on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Earlier that week, Imran's sister Aleema Khan had also been denied entry on June 1. PTI leadership indicated it would file a contempt of court petition, citing systematic obstruction of court orders.

media.caption: PTI leaders barred from meeting Imran Khan at Adiala Jail despite IHC court order

title: Pakistan Confirms Rs 17.1 Trillion Federal Budget for FY2026-27 to Be Presented June 10
detail: Deputy PM and Finance Minister Ishaq Dar confirmed that Pakistan's federal budget for fiscal year 2026-27 will be presented to the National Assembly on June 10, 2026. The proposed budget of Rs 17.1 trillion targets 4.1% GDP growth, Rs 15.267 trillion in Federal Board of Revenue tax collection, and projects average inflation of 8.4% — reflecting IMF program constraints and inflationary pressures from the Iran-Israel conflict driving up fuel costs. The Economic Survey 2025-26 is scheduled for release on June 9. The budget must satisfy IMF benchmarks under the ongoing Extended Fund Facility and Resilience and Sustainability Facility programs.

media.caption: Pakistan announces Rs 17.1 trillion federal budget for FY2026-27 to be presented June 10
